description: Na₂LaPS₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.58 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.41 Å. La is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent S and three O atoms. There is one shorter (3.08 Å) and one longer (3.09 Å) La-S bond length. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.35 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-41°. There are three shorter (1.56 Å) and one longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond length. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent La and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 1.97 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one S and three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.50 Å) and one longer (1.51 Å) S-O bond length. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom.
